name: Tinnitus

rating_logic.summary: Schedular maximum is generally 10% for recurrent tinnitus (single evaluation rule).

evidence_checklist: Current symptoms described (frequency, impact on sleep/focus)
Medical/audiology notes mentioning tinnitus (if available)
Service event/exposure history (e.g., hazardous noise) documented in records if it exists
Treatment history (hearing protection, audiology visits, etc.)
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Limitation of Flexion of the Knee

rating_logic.summary: Rating depends on measured flexion (degrees).

evidence_checklist: Range-of-motion measurements (flexion) from exam or treatment notes
Pain with motion / flare-up notes (how often, how severe)
Functional impact (stairs, standing, walking, kneeling)
Imaging and treatment history (PT, injections, braces) if documented
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Paralysis of the Sciatic Nerve (Sciatica)

rating_logic.summary: Rating is based on severity (mild → complete).

excerpts.label: Rating criteria excerpt
excerpts.text: Mild incomplete paralysis of the sciatic nerve warrants a 10 percent evaluation. Moderate incomplete paralysis warrants 20 percent...

evidence_checklist: Symptoms + pattern (radiating pain, numbness, weakness)
Neuro findings (reflexes, strength, sensation) if documented
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Hearing Loss

rating_logic.summary: Rating uses puretone thresholds + speech discrimination to find Roman numerals (Tables VI/VIa) and combine them (Table VII).

evidence_checklist: Audiogram results (puretone thresholds at 1000/2000/3000/4000 Hz)
Maryland CNC speech discrimination scores
Hearing-related functional impact (work/communication)
Noise exposure history if documented
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

cfr.title: General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders (PTSD)

rating_logic.summary: PTSD is evaluated under the General Rating Formula (0–100%) based on occupational and social impairment and symptoms.

evidence_checklist: Mental health diagnosis and treatment notes (therapy/medication) if present
Symptom frequency/severity and functional impact (work, relationships, sleep)
Stressors/events documented where possible (records or statements)
Any relevant exam results (e.g., C&P mental health exam) if performed
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Migraine Headaches

rating_logic.summary: Ratings depend on frequency and severity of prostrating attacks.

levels.level: Characteristic prostrating attacks averaging one in 2 months
Characteristic prostrating attacks occurring on average once a month
Very frequent completely prostrating and prolonged attacks with severe economic inadaptability

strategy: Document frequency and severity of headaches.
Describe prostrating attacks (needing to lie down).
Show functional impact (missed work, reduced productivity).
Match symptoms to DC 8100 language (severity ladder).
evidence_checklist: Frequency and severity of headaches documented in medical records or statements
Notes describing prostrating attacks (needing to lie down, inability to function)
Impact on work, concentration, or daily functioning
Treatment history (medication, neurology visits, ER visits if applicable)
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Sleep Apnea (including obstructive sleep apnea)

rating_logic.summary: Sleep apnea ratings depend largely on CPAP use and respiratory complications.

evidence_checklist: Sleep study confirming diagnosis
CPAP prescription or treatment documentation
Functional impact such as daytime fatigue
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Asthma (Bronchial)

rating_logic.summary: Asthma ratings consider pulmonary testing results and medication use.

evidence_checklist: Pulmonary function testing results
Medication usage history
Frequency of exacerbations
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

evidence_checklist: Mental health diagnosis and treatment notes if present
Symptom severity/frequency (panic, avoidance, hypervigilance, concentration issues)
Functional impact on work, relationships, and sleep

name: Insomnia Disorder

cfr.title: General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders (Insomnia Disorder)

evidence_checklist: Sleep complaints documented over time
Functional impact such as fatigue, missed work, concentration problems, or irritability
Treatment history (medications, sleep hygiene, therapy, sleep clinic if applicable)

name: Adjustment Disorder

cfr.title: General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders (Adjustment Disorder)

rating_logic.summary: Adjustment disorder is evaluated under the General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders.

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis or counseling notes identifying adjustment disorder
Triggering stressor/event described in records or statements where available
Symptom severity and duration
Functional impact on work, school, relationships, or daily activities
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Peripheral Vestibular Disorder / Vertigo

rating_logic.summary: Vertigo/peripheral vestibular disorders are generally rated based on dizziness and staggering severity.

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis/workup by ENT, audiology, neurology, or treating clinician if available
Frequency of dizziness/vertigo episodes
Balance problems, falls, staggering, or safety impact
Treatment history and any vestibular testing
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Peripheral Neuropathy (Lower Extremity)

rating_logic.summary: Peripheral neuropathy is often evaluated by the affected nerve and severity of incomplete paralysis.

evidence_checklist: Symptoms documented (numbness, tingling, burning, weakness)
Neuro findings such as sensation, strength, or reflex changes if present
Affected area and side clearly described
Functional impact on walking, balance, standing, or driving
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Lumbosacral Strain / Low Back Condition

rating_logic.summary: Low back conditions are commonly rated under the General Rating Formula for the Spine using range of motion, guarding/spasm, and functional loss.

evidence_checklist: Range of motion findings or exam measurements if available
Flare-ups, painful motion, and limits on lifting, standing, bending, or walking
Imaging, PT, injections, medications, or specialist notes if documented
Any associated radicular symptoms or neurologic findings
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Cervical Strain / Neck Condition

rating_logic.summary: Neck conditions are commonly rated under the General Rating Formula for the Spine using range of motion and functional loss.

evidence_checklist: Neck range-of-motion findings if available
Pain, stiffness, guarding, flare-ups, and functional impact
Imaging, treatment notes, PT, injections, or medications if documented
Any radiating symptoms into shoulders/arms if present
disclaimer: Educational CFR mapping only. Not legal advice or representation.

name: Limitation of Extension of the Knee

rating_logic.summary: Rating depends on measured limitation of extension and related functional loss.

evidence_checklist: Range-of-motion measurements for extension
Painful motion, flare-ups, and instability/functional impact
Treatment history such as braces, PT, injections, or surgery if documented
Effect on stairs, standing, walking, kneeling, or squatting

name: Shoulder Limitation of Motion

evidence_checklist: Range-of-motion findings for lifting/raising the arm
Painful motion, weakness, flare-ups, and repetitive-use problems
Functional impact with reaching, carrying, dressing, or overhead activity
Imaging, PT, injections, surgery, or specialist notes if documented

name: Limited Motion of the Ankle

rating_logic.summary: Ankle ratings commonly consider marked versus moderate limitation of motion and functional loss.

evidence_checklist: Range-of-motion findings and painful motion
Instability, swelling, flare-ups, brace use, or falls
Functional impact with walking, standing, stairs, or running
Imaging and treatment history if documented

name: Plantar Fasciitis

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis and location/laterality of foot pain
Standing/walking tolerance and daily functional impact
Orthotics, injections, PT, surgery, or other treatment history
Whether symptoms persist despite treatment

name: Chronic Sinusitis

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis or recurrent sinus complaints documented in treatment notes
Frequency of episodes, infections, antibiotics, or physician visits
Headaches, facial pain, drainage, crusting, or related symptoms

name: Allergic Rhinitis

rating_logic.summary: Rhinitis ratings commonly consider obstruction, polyps, and chronic symptoms.

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis and chronic nasal symptoms documented
Degree of obstruction or mention of polyps if evaluated
Medication history such as sprays, antihistamines, or allergy treatment
Functional impact such as sleep disruption or chronic congestion

name: GERD / Reflux Condition

cfr.title: Hiatal hernia (often used analogously for reflux symptoms)

Frequency/severity of reflux, regurgitation, chest pain, dysphagia, or sleep disruption
Medication and treatment history
Functional impact such as interrupted sleep, diet restrictions, or work impact

name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis or consistent GI complaints documented
Frequency of diarrhea, constipation, urgency, or cramping
Functional impact such as missed work, bathroom access issues, or diet restriction
GI treatment, workup, medications, or specialist notes if available

name: Hypertension

rating_logic.summary: Hypertension ratings commonly depend on blood pressure readings and medication history.

Medication history and whether continuous medication is required
Diagnosis documented by treating clinician

name: Erectile Dysfunction

evidence_checklist: Diagnosis or consistent complaint documented
Medication/treatment history and whether symptoms persist
Relationship to another service-connected condition or treatment if claimed secondary
Provider notes describing onset and functional impact

name: Painful or Unstable Scars

rating_logic.summary: Scar ratings often depend on whether scars are painful, unstable, numerous, large, or functionally limiting.

evidence_checklist: Location and number of scars clearly documented
Whether scars are painful, unstable, or repeatedly break down
Measurements/photos or clinical descriptions if available
Functional impact or tenderness described in notes or statements

name: Radiculopathy (Upper Extremity)

rating_logic.summary: Upper-extremity radiculopathy is often evaluated by the affected nerve/radicular group and severity.

evidence_checklist: Symptoms documented (radiating pain, numbness, tingling, weakness)
Affected side and extremity clearly identified
Neuro findings such as reflexes, strength, or sensation if present
Impact on lifting, grip, typing, driving, sleep, or daily tasks

name: Shoulder Instability / Recurrent Dislocation

Guarding, brace/sling use, or activity avoidance
Functional impact on reaching, lifting, carrying, or overhead tasks
Imaging, surgery, PT, or orthopedic follow-up if present

name: Chronic Nasal / Sinus Symptoms

rating_logic.summary: Chronic nasal/sinus symptom cases often turn on the specific diagnosis, obstruction, episode history, and treatment record.

evidence_checklist: Consistent nasal/sinus complaints documented over time
Whether symptoms fit rhinitis, sinusitis, or both
Medication history such as sprays, antihistamines, or antibiotics
Sleep impact, headaches, drainage, obstruction, or ENT follow-up
